Mayfair CNRA:
The Mayfair neighborhood basically follows the grid pattern of streets, with a significant number of short, narrow roadways. The northern border is Alum Rock Avenue, a six-lane arterial which is the easterly extension of Santa Clara Street. King Road, a major north/south collector, forms the western edge of the neighborhood. Another major collector street, San Antonio Street, bisects the area parallel to Alum Rock Avenue. A third major collector, Jackson Avenue, crosses the easterly portion of the project area, intersection Alum Rock Avenue and San Antonio Street before passing beneath and linking to Route 680. The latter freeway passes around Mayfair on the east and south, with access ramps at Alum Rock and Jackson Avenues, and San Antonio Street. The Mayfair CNRA extends slighly east of Route 680 to include Summer Street, a one block dead end roadway. Access to Summer Street is from Dobern Avenue, north of the Project boundary.

Transit Data
Three County Transit routes serve the Mayfair neighborhood: line 22 from downtown follows King Road south to Eastridge; line 21, also from downtown, extends easterly on Alum Rock Avenue to the foothills; and line 70, connects south San Jose with the Berryessa area along Jackson Avenue.
